text:
anya: Need to schedule a base-image rebuild and runtime attestor rollout. KMS keywrap rotation + RBAC tightening planned. Thinking Sunday 02:00 UTC for a 3-node canary in eu-west-1. Any blockers?
phil: Sunday works for me. Can we avoid touching clusterrolebindings? prefer namespaced RoleBindings scoped to machinepools.
sam: Agree. I'll prepare a namespaced Role that only allows `get`/`list` on `imageattestations` and a RoleBinding to the runtime SA. No cluster roles.
nina: Audit note: we should ensure the attestor webhook emits an `image.verify` audit.log field. Add a policy to capture the webhook's namespace/events. I can author the audit-policy diff.
anya: Good. Also require SBOMs for every image build and upload path to `sbom-prod/redwood/base/` with timestamped filenames. That helps vuln triage if canary fails.
oncall-bot: preflight reminder: run `make smoke-canary` and `./ci/verify-sbom.sh` before 2025-12-07T00:00:00Z.
phil: KMS roles: I'm trying to avoid granting Sign on the node role. Plan: cosign-key-signer SA in infra namespace (sign-only), runtime-decrypt SA with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey* limited by Condition: `aws:PrincipalArn` == runtime node role.
sam: Paste minimal IAM statement as a snippet in PR so reviewers can eyeball it.
anya: We must also ensure kubelet has access to decrypt the image key at boot. That means projected service account token mount + short-lived KMS auth token, not static secrets.
ina: For monitoring, I'll add an Elastalert rule: trigger if `k8s_audit.image.verify:fail` >= 3 in 5m from the canary nodes. Also create a dashboard tile for quick triage.
phil: Rollout plan: canary (3 nodes) -> wait 30m -> if green, expand to half cluster -> wait 60m -> full. If any verification fails during canary, hold and triage.
oncall-bot: Deploy window: 2025-12-07T02:00:00Z - 2025-12-07T05:00:00Z. Canary end: +30m.
sam: Contingency: if node fails to fetch key, fallback is to redeploy machine with previous image digest. I added `machine-template.metadata.annotations.previous-digest` in the machinepool manifest to make that quick.
anya: Who owns incident lead during the window? I'll take first 90 minutes. Phil backup for rollback and RBAC revert. Nina will watch audit stream and SBOM uploads.
ina: Also add an automated step to archive the cosigned public keys to the keyserver with date/version tag before rotate. Keeps provenance clear for triage.
phil: I'm opening two PRs: /pr/6101 (IAM + Role/RoleBinding + machine annotation) and /pr/6102 (audit-policy + elastalert rules). Please review quickly.
sam: Quick heads-up: staging job flagged a lint in the audit-policy (missing namespace filter). Fixing now and will push a new commit.
anya: Make sure the preflight includes `kubectl auth can-i get imageattestations --as=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-decrypt-sa` from a node to verify RBAC before cutover.
oncall-bot: Note: If preflight fails twice, window auto-cancels.
phil: Also add docs to run `cosign verify --key <truststore> <image>` locally and to inspect SBOM in case of verification mismatch. I'll add to runbook.
anya: Action items recap in this thread:
- sam: update PR with fixed audit-policy + machine annotation (link when ready)
- phil: runbook additions + backup rollback commands
- nina: elastalert + dashboard + SBOM upload verification
- anya: coordinate oncall handoff and run preflight at 23:30 UTC
Please post PR links and tag me.
sam: PRs posted: /pr/6101 (updated) /pr/6102 (audit fix). PTAL.
phil: Reviewed /pr/6101, left a comment about adding a Condition on KMS key ID to the IAM policy.
nina: Verified SBOM upload path in staging and smoke canary passes once I fixed audit-policy.
anya: Thanks. If anything trips the Elastalert during canary, we'll pause and run the rollback. Otherwise proceed with half-cluster at +30m. :thumbsup:
